implemented: Successful journaled mutations retain host-only before/after fileDiff metadata. AgentPresentation projects it into stable tool rows; four provider serializers exclude it from outbound requests.
Readonly native colored line diffs preserve selection across streaming refresh, distinguish empty creation/deletion, show newline changes and bound oversized previews.
Raster attachment/file links open native fit/100-percent/zoom/pan previews. Inline images use the same conversation-owned resolver and validated raster decoder.
Message-to-workspace provenance persists outside model content. Restart restores physical-directory authority; replaced roots, missing historical bindings and foreign owners are rejected.
Forked workspace provenance is rebound only after matching the physical root; saved attachment context remains per chat. Shell links open only sessions known to their owning host.
limits: Diff previews accept strict UTF-8 text and omit binary/oversized data; mutation storage still retains exact bytes within its own bounds.
PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/ICO/AVIF signatures are accepted only when the static Qt decoder is present. SVG, remote URLs and implicit file/data resource loads are rejected.
Animated media displays its first decoded frame. PDF/Office/media viewers and full source Monaco/LSP/diff editing are not implemented by this slice.
Imported legacy rows without trusted mount provenance cannot authorize current-workspace links. Hosted app and shell-log transcript previews are separate from ordinary file mount previews.

finalSharedIntegration.scope: Named suite reports and exact tested source hashes are retained in the final aggregate. Focused/historical evidence above remains scoped to its original observation; full upstream parity is not implied.
